_comment: protected lists before enabling -Apply. Every byte figure is exact bytes. Every
section is a CLOSED schema: an unknown or misspelled key fails validation.
Tiers: normal (routine hygiene only) < elevated < critical; each rule names the
lowest tier at which it may STOP a process. Below that tier it only reports.
Pressure legs: free physical RAM, commit charge / physical RAM, and COMMIT
HEADROOM (commit limit - commit charge, the quantity whose exhaustion fails
allocations). Calibrated on the 02.09.2026 04:50 EEST measurement of the owner's
31.6 GB box (3.5 GB free / 67.7 GB committed = 2.14x): free RAM makes it
elevated; the ratio leg for critical is 2.5x on purpose - 2.0x sits BELOW this
box's chronic baseline and would make critical a permanent standing state.

cursor-agent.resumeHint: chat is checkpointed in ~/.cursor/chats; resume with `agent --resume <chatId>` (or `agent ls` to pick); only an interrupted turn is lost

claude-code.resumeHint: transcript is appended live to ~/.claude/projects/<cwd>/<id>.jsonl; resume with `claude --resume <id>` or `claude -c` in the same folder; set DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 before relaunch (the updater is the dominant leak)

codex.resumeHint: rollout is written live to ~/.codex/sessions/<date>/rollout-*.jsonl; resume with `codex resume --last --all` or `codex resume <uuid>`

grok.resumeHint: session lives under ~/.grok/sessions; resume with `grok --resume <uuid>` or `grok -c` in the same folder

goose.resumeHint: sessions are in %APPDATA%\Block\goose\data\sessions\sessions.db; resume with `goose session -r --name <name>` (`goose session list`)

retired.remediation: AgentBridge was retired 2026-07-27 (CLAUDE.md: its daemon does not run and its tools are gone). The parent_chain in this record names the launcher; remove the agentbridge MCP entry from that launcher's config - expected C:/Users/Prekzursil/.grok/config.toml ([mcp_servers.agentbridge]) or the Grok plugin list - so it stops respawning. Killing the instance alone only buys the next crash-loop cycle; after crashLoopKills kills in a day the supervisor stops killing it and reports crash-loop instead.

_comment: Report-only. Launcher shapes whose real server is a GRANDCHILD of the
host: libuv hosts (Cursor, the VS Code extension host) put their direct
child in a job with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE *and* SILENT_BREAKAWAY_OK, which
deliberately excludes grandchildren - so `cmd /c npx <server>` outlives
the host and becomes the orphan the reaper later cleans up. Rewriting the
config to `node.exe <entry.js>` makes the server the direct child, and
Windows reaps it with the host. Set tokens to [] to silence the rule.
